page.overview:
Who is Zombie?

Adult:Height: 1.95 BlocksWidth: 0.6 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.975 BlocksWidth: 0.3 Blocks : Adult:Height: 1.9 BlocksWidth: 0.6 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.95 BlocksWidth: 0.3 Blocks

Zombies are common undead hostile mobs that deal melee damage and occasionally attack in groups.

Zombies may spawn in the Overworld in groups of up to four above solid blocks at a light level of 0, except in mushroom fields and deep dark biomes. All zombies spawned in desert biomes and exposed to the sky have a likelihood of 80%/70% to be replaced by husks. Zombies that are not husks or drowned have a 5% chance to spawn as zombie villagers. Zombies may spawn with armor and a weapon.

Zombie variants have a 5% chance to spawn as babies. The baby zombies also have a chance of spawning as a chicken jockey .

entity.description:
Liu Kang was an infamous example of a zombie in the MK series. Raiden, who was corrupted by his death, had used necromancy to reanimate Liu Kang's body as an enforcer of the dark thunder god's will. Raiden had then unleashed Liu Kang's active corpse to destroy those who Raiden believes have caused harm to Earthrealm.

In Mortal Kombat: Deceptions Konquest mode, zombies are shown to endlessly roam the wastelands of the Netherrealm. They were identified by an Oni Guard as beings that are "punished to roam the wastelands as reanimated dead".

Other zombies seen in the series would be the "undead" clan of Scorpion. The Elder Gods had promised to resurrect Scorpion's clan in exchange for his service to them as their champion. Unfortunately for Scorpion, the Elder Gods did not fully fulfill their promise as they had brought back the Shirai Ryu as animated dead. Infuriated, Scorpion vowed revenge against the Elder Gods. Scorpion attempted his revenge by sending his undead clan to kill Taven in order to ruin the Elder God's plans to save the realms from Armageddon. However, Taven was able to defeat the undead Shirai Ryu.
